_note: Synthetic, simplified ladder for the demo, inspired by public frameworks (sdras/career-ladders MIT, Dropbox). Not any company's real ladder.

Senior.Technical scope: Owns features and services within one team
Senior.Influence: Trusted reviewer and go-to person on the team
Senior.Direction: Breaks down projects the team has already chosen

Staff.Technical scope: Owns systems that span multiple teams
Staff.Impact: Delivers outcomes leadership tracks by name
Staff.Influence: Aligns several teams without authority; writes decisions others follow
Staff.Direction: Identifies the right problems to work on, not just how to solve them
Staff.Growing others: Grows senior engineers; sponsors people for opportunities

Principal.Influence: Recognized voice inside and outside the company
Principal.Growing others: Builds the next generation of Staff engineers

Engineering Manager.Technical scope: Understands the team's systems well enough to make tradeoffs
Engineering Manager.Impact: Team delivers predictably and improves over time
Engineering Manager.Influence: Represents the team to partners and leadership
Engineering Manager.Direction: Sets team roadmap with product partners
Engineering Manager.Growing others: Hires, coaches and promotes engineers; gives clear feedback
